candidate_facts.text: The United Nations Security Council passed Resolution 82 on June 25, 1950.
Resolution 82 authorized member states to provide military assistance to South Korea.
The authorization was in response to the North Korean invasion.
The United States led a UN coalition in the Korean War.
The majority of combat power in the UN coalition came from U.S. forces.
The Korean War ended with an armistice signed on July 27, 1953.
The armistice was signed by North Korea, South Korea, China, and the United Nations.
No formal peace treaty was ever ratified after the Korean War.
